 Career Summary 
Senior Business Analyst with extensive experience delivering digital lending and mortgage platform transformations across retail banking ecosystems. 
Proven expertise analyzing and improving end-to-end lending journeys including application capture, credit assessment, underwriting, decisioning, loan 
origination, and servicing. Specialized in Salesforce-enabled lending ecosystems, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and API-driven fintech integrations 
supporting broker, direct, and partner channels. Experienced working closely with credit policy teams, brokers, operations, product owners, and 
technology partners to design scalable, compliant, and customer-centric lending platforms. Strong capabilities in process modelling (BPMN), workflow 
automation, decisioning logic, requirements engineering, and UAT strategy, ensuring lending platforms deliver operational efficiency, improved broker 
experience, and regulatory compliance. 
 Skills Summary 
• DOMAIN and FUNCTIONAL EXPERTISE - End-to-end loan origination lifecycle: lead sourcing, application capture, credit assessment, underwriting, 
decisioning, loan booking, and servicing; Loan Origination Systems (LOS) workflow design and rule-based credit decisioning; Credit policy translation 
into platform logic, eligibility rules, and automated decisioning; Broker / DSA / fintech lead ingestion and application orchestration; Digital lending 
journeys including KYC, bureau checks, document verification, eSign, disbursement; Customer journey optimization across digital lending channels
• REQUIREMENTS and BUSINESS ANALYSIS - Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Specification Document (FSD), User Stories,
Acceptance Criteria, Data Dictionary, Process Flows (AS-IS / TO-BE), Gap Analysis, Impact Analysis, Stakeholder Workshops, Backlog Refinement,
Definition of Done (DoD), UAT Strategy, Test Scenarios, Defect Triage, Traceability (RTM)
• TECHNICAL and DATA ACUMEN - API Integrations (REST), JSON, XML, SQL, Data Mapping & Transformation, Core Banking Integrations, Credit
Bureau Integrations, KYC & Verification Systems, Swagger / Postman API Validation, Data Validation & Reconciliation, Error Handling & Integration 
Behavior, Event-Driven Integrations
• TOOLS and PLATFORMS - Power BI, Jira, Confluence, MS Excel (Pivot Tables, Lookups), Visio, BPMN, Figma, Draw.io, Postman, Swagger, SQL 
• GOVERNANCE and DELIVERY - Agile / Scrum Delivery, UAT Planning & Execution, Release Readiness, Change Management, Risk & Dependency
Management, Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination, Compliance Alignment, Audit Readiness, Production Go-Live & Post-Deployment Stabilization
 Professional Summary 
• Led end-to-end business analysis for digital lending platform initiatives, covering loan application capture, credit assessment, underwriting
workflows, decisioning, and loan origination.
• Facilitated structured workshops with credit, operations, product, fintech partners, and technology teams to identify pain points in lending journeys 
and design improved platform workflows.
• Analyzed AS-IS loan origination processes and designed TO-BE lending workflows to improve decisioning speed, reduce manual intervention, and

products.

• Drove stakeholder reviews and obtained formal sign-offs across business and technology teams.
• Planned and tracked development sprints and release schedules.
• Acted as a single point of coordination between business, product, technology, operations, and external vendors.
• Facilitated requirement discussions, solution design reviews, and implementation workshops.
